title: Class of service
description: The handling class for a shipment — standard, express, fragile, or cold-chain. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when handling class is material to the order. Most buyer↔seller relationships (a review, a license, a consultation) need no shipping class; split out of figaro-geo so logistics attributes are never unconditionally mandatory.

fields.name: classOfService
fields.label: Class of service
fields.description: Handling class. S = Standard (room temperature, not fragile). E = Express (priority window). F = Fragile (handle with care). C = Cold Chain (refrigerated transport required).
